prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “official” service that tells you whether ChatGPT or other LLMs recommend your business. Instead use a combination of (A) the main place/data providers LLMs pull from, (B) local-SEO/listings platforms that monitor and distribute your facts, and (C) direct tests against the LLMs. For most small businesses a practical stack is:

1) Verify and control the source data (highest impact)
- Google Business Profile (must). Verify and keep hours, categories, photos, and reviews up to date.
- Bing Places, Apple Maps, Yelp, Facebook/Meta, TripAdvisor (if relevant).
Why: these are primary authoritative sources that search engines and many AI systems use.

2) Use a listings/citation manager to keep info consistent and feed partners
- Yext — enterprise-grade, pushes authoritative data to many partners and has products aimed at making businesses show up in AI-driven responses.
- BrightLocal or Whitespark — cheaper/local-SEO-focused, great for tracking local rankings and citations.
- Moz Local or Semrush Listing Management — good if you already use those SEO suites.
Why: they help keep Name/Address/Phone (NAP) consistency and citation coverage (which LLMs indirectly use).

3) Monitor local search and reputation
- BrightLocal and Whitespark offer rank tracking for local search queries (helps predict whether AI will surface you).
- Semrush and Moz provide brand monitoring, backlink and keyword tracking.
- Google Business Profile Insights & Yelp for business owner dashboards give direct signals.

4) Test the AIs directly (simple and reliable)
- Manually: ask ChatGPT, Bing Chat, Google Bard, etc. “What are the best [service] in [city]?” or “Do you recommend [Business Name] in [city]?” Try multiple phrasings and prompt contexts.
- Programmatic: if you want recurring checks, run automated queries against OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google PaLM APIs (or use tools like PromptLayer/LangChain to orchestrate) and parse results for mentions.
Why: LLM answers can vary; testing directly tells you what real users see.

5) Improve signals AI rely on
- Add LocalBusiness schema.org markup to your website.
- Get more good reviews on major sites (Google, Yelp).
- Earn links and mentions on reputable local sites and directories.
- Keep press/authority presence (local news, industry sites).

Which single “best” to pick depends on budget and goals
- If budget is limited and you want to monitor/track local visibility: BrightLocal or Whitespark.
- If you want authoritative distribution to many AI/search partners and can invest: Yext.
- If you already use a full SEO suite: use Semrush or Moz’s local/listing features.

If you want, I can:
- Run a quick test now — ask ChatGPT/Bing/Bard about your business (give business name + city).
- Recommend the best tool for your budget/region/industry if you tell me those constraints.
